questions.stem: How can a mutation lead to a change in the protein produced by a gene?

options.text: By changing the sequence of bases, which changes the amino acid sequence
By increasing the number of ribosomes in the cell
By removing all the chromosomes from the cell
By stopping the cell from dividing

questions.explanation: A change in the DNA base sequence can alter which amino acids are coded for. This changes the protein's amino acid sequence, which may change its shape and function.
